Indian President to Visit Three European Countries for Diplomatic Talks

President Droupadi Murmu is embarking on a three-nation European tour to strengthen diplomatic ties with countries in Moldova, North Macedonia, and Romania. The visit aims to promote India's interests abroad and foster cooperation in various fields.
